translations.web: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
translations.bsb: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
translations.kjv: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
translations.asv: He will send from heaven, and save me, When he that would swallow me up reproacheth; Selah God will send forth his lovingkindness and his truth.
